commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP: backup fstab =="
sudo -n cp -a /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.bak.$(date +%s)

echo "== STEP: ensure /tmp tmpfs entry =="
if ! grep -qE '^\S+\s+/tmp\s+tmpfs' /etc/fstab; then
  echo "tmpfs /tmp tmpfs defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab
else
  echo "/tmp entry already present"
fi

echo "== STEP: ensure /dev/shm tmpfs entry =="
if ! grep -qE '^\S+\s+/dev/shm\s+tmpfs' /etc/fstab; then
  echo "tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab
else
  echo "/dev/shm entry already present"
fi

echo "== STEP: daemon-reload =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload

echo "== STEP: mount /tmp (fresh tmpfs mount from fstab) =="
sudo -n mount /tmp

echo "== STEP: remount /dev/shm with new options =="
sudo -n mount -o remount /dev/shm

echo "== VERIFY findmnt /tmp =="
findmnt /tmp

echo "== VERIFY findmnt /dev/shm =="
findmnt /dev/shm

echo "== VERIFY fstab entries =="
grep -E '/tmp|/dev/shm' /etc/fstab

echo "== FUNCTIONAL TEST: noexec on /tmp =="
printf '#!/bin/sh\necho hi\n' > /tmp/exectest.sh
chmod +x /tmp/exectest.sh
if /tmp/exectest.sh 2>/tmp/exectest.err; then
  echo "FAIL: script executed on /tmp"
else
  echo "PASS: execution blocked on /tmp"
  cat /tmp/exectest.err
fi

echo "== FUNCTIONAL TEST: noexec on /dev/shm =="
printf '#!/bin/sh\necho hi\n' > /dev/shm/exectest.sh
chmod +x /dev/shm/exectest.sh
if /dev/shm/exectest.sh 2>/dev/shm/exectest.err; then
  echo "FAIL: script executed on /dev/shm"
else
  echo "PASS: execution blocked on /dev/shm"
  cat /dev/shm/exectest.err
fi
rm -f /tmp/exectest.sh /tmp/exectest.err /dev/shm/exectest.sh /dev/shm/exectest.err
